questions.question: Which placental hormones primarily drive the approximately weekly growth rate (~6–7%) observed in uterine leiomyomas during early pregnancy?

On ultrasound and MRI, which characteristics allow differentiation between a decidualized endometrioma and a cystically degenerating intramural/subserosal leiomyoma when both appear as large unilocular adnexal cysts?

In a nulliparous woman at 21 weeks gestation presenting with severe abdominal pain, dyspnea, and two large pelvic cystic masses, what clinical indicators justify proceeding with operative intervention rather than expectant management while preserving her pregnancy?
Why does serum CA‑125 typically rise only during the first (~23 U/mL) and third (~21 U/mL) trimesters of normal pregnancy while remaining near reference limits during the second trimester?

"During laparotomy," after diagnosing an upper cranial pedunculated fibroid twisted around its pedicle, what specific intraoperative measures were taken to prevent uterine hemorrhage while maintaining fetal viability?
"Postoperatively" bleeding led her hemoglobin level to fall from 9.9 g/dL pre‑op to 7.5 g/dL post‑op; why was intravenous ferric carboxymaltose chosen over oral iron supplementation?

"Spontaneous resolution" occurred where the residual pelvic myoma shrank from ~9 cm pre‑op to ~7½ cm at discharge; which physiological processes following removal explain this size reduction without additional intervention?
